title: Epoch-bound ADC FIFO to DMA to RAM consumer lineage
domain: One fixed RP2040 acquisition epoch and one declared ADC FIFO, DMA channel, destination window and consumer read
conditional_conclusion: For the declared ordinary finite queue model, the kth consumer-read slot descends from the kth conversion in the current acquisition epoch.
proof_role: Standard ordered-queue induction under all listed premises; exact enumeration checks finite drop-one counterexamples but is not the proof of arbitrary-length sufficiency.
counterexample: Constant payload 0x555 with one stale pre-start FIFO entry yields the same final buffer and terminal status as a clean run while changing first-slot epoch lineage.

thought_experiment_role.varied: Whether the first FIFO occurrence belongs to the current acquisition epoch
thought_experiment_role.refutes: Value and terminal-state equality suffices for current-epoch actual lineage
